privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: AradExperience is the Arad city app for events, guided sights, local offers and community actions. This page explains which data we use and why.

account.title: Your account
account.text: Your name and phone number (and, for businesses, an email address and a password stored encrypted) create your account; we also keep the moment you accepted the Terms and conditions. On your phone the app only remembers your session (a token), so you don't have to sign in every time.

activity.title: What you do in the app
activity.text: We save your tickets and bookings, saved events, community action sign-ups, points earned and spent, redeemed offers and your itineraries, so you can see them any time.

location.title: Location
location.text: Location is used only when you allow it, on your phone, for the map, routes and "near me". Coordinates are sent on request to compute distances and are not stored in your account.

camera.title: Camera
camera.text: The camera only turns on when you scan a QR code (tickets, offers, actions). Images are not stored and never leave your phone.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.text: Messages you send to the assistant are processed by Anthropic (Claude) only to answer you, together with the list of public events. Don't send personal data in the chat.

storage.title: Where data is stored
storage.text: Data is stored on Amazon Web Services servers in the European Union (Stockholm). We don't sell data and don't use it for ads.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask for a copy of your data or for your account to be deleted at any time, together with the related tickets, points and sign-ups.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to the AradExperience app and website. By creating an account you confirm that you have read them and agree to them and to the Privacy policy.

about.title: About the service
about.text: AradExperience helps you find events, guided sights, public transport, local offers and community actions in Arad. It is free to use; you only pay for tickets to paid events.

account.title: Your account
account.text: You must be at least 16 to create an account. Use real details and keep your phone and password safe: you are responsible for what happens in your account. A business account is checked by the City Hall before its posts and offers become public.

use.title: Fair use
use.text: Do not post illegal, offensive or misleading content, do not send spam and do not try to access other people's accounts or game the points and codes. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

tickets.title: Tickets and payments
tickets.text: Tickets are issued for the event organiser and paid through Stripe. Cancellations and refunds follow the organiser's rules shown on the event. A ticket's QR code is personal and can be scanned only once.

points.title: Points, offers and actions
points.text: Points are earned for confirmed participation in community actions; they have no cash value and cannot be transferred. Offers are provided by businesses, who are responsible for them.

info.title: Information in the app
info.text: CTP departures, event schedules, parking and other data come from public sources and may contain errors or delays. The AI assistant can be wrong: check its answers before important decisions.

data.title: Your data
data.text: We use personal data only as described in the Privacy policy. We keep the moment you accepted these terms. You can ask for a copy of your data or for your account to be deleted at any time.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: If we change these terms we will tell you in the app; for important changes we will ask for your consent again.

law.title: Governing law
law.text: Romanian law applies. If we cannot settle a dispute amicably, it goes to the courts in Arad; as a consumer you can also contact ANPC.
